class.name: RealityControllerXRInterface
class.brief_description: Shared spatial-controller tracking for RealityKit volumes.
class.description: Available from [method XRServer.find_interface] as [code]GDRKAccessoryControllerTracker[/code]. Physical controller input and ARKit tracking are shared. Each volume publishes poses in its own Godot coordinate space. Use [XRController3D] and [method XRInterface.trigger_haptic_pulse] with the returned tracker names. No direct mapping to 2D controls is provided. Initialization requires supported hardware; connection does not imply a valid pose. The global tracking status considers all volumes. The default pose has grip semantics. When the device supplies them, [code]grip[/code], [code]aim[/code] and [code]palm[/code] (ARKit grip surface) include transformed system linear/angular velocity and tracking confidence. Query supported capabilities instead of assuming every input or pose exists. Haptic requests are per tracker. Zero amplitude cancels only that tracker. Overlapping requests on the same physical hand use the strongest amplitude; the strongest request supplies frequency. Closure, destruction, tracking loss and disconnect clear the affected requests. Godot haptic frequency is mapped to system sharpness; exact physical frequency is not guaranteed.

method.name: tracker_for_node
method.description: Returns the owning volume tracker for [code]left_hand[/code] or [code]right_hand[/code]. Returns an empty name for an invalid hand, node outside a volume, uninitialized interface or destroying volume.

method.name: tracker_for_volume
method.description: Returns a stable tracker name for the volume and hand. Main names remain [code]left_hand[/code] and [code]right_hand[/code]. Closed volumes retain their names but have invalid poses. Invalid IDs/hands or an uninitialized interface return an empty name.

method.name: is_controller_connected
method.description: Returns whether a recognized physical controller is connected for the hand, regardless of volume pose validity. Hand must be left_hand or right_hand.

method.name: get_supported_inputs
method.description: Returns inputs actually exposed by the controller. Existing names are trigger, trigger_click, grip, grip_click, primary, primary_click, ax_button, by_button and menu_button. Optional touched states are trigger_touch, grip_touch, primary_touch, ax_touch and by_touch. Hand must be left_hand or right_hand.

method.name: get_supported_poses
method.description: Returns the available pose names, including default when grip is supported. Hand must be left_hand or right_hand.

method.name: supports_haptics
method.description: Returns whether the connected controller exposes a haptic locality. Hand must be left_hand or right_hand.

method.name: log_diagnostic
method.description: Writes a message to the native console.

signal.name: controller_capabilities_changed
signal.description: Input, pose or haptic capabilities changed; query again.

signal.name: tracking_error
signal.description: ARKit setup, provider operation or coordinate conversion failed. A failure does not imply a physical disconnect.
